name: Kostas
source:
Emperor Kostas of Galens was once a proud pillar of the Empire and won the respect of all he ruled.

But now he has fallen ill and retired away from public affairs, leaving governing to his oldest son. Despite everything, he still commands the respect and love of his family and subjects.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/teamgalens/status/1666852592289296400]Twitter[/url]]
